name: openenlink
description: Connect to Enlink campus networks through a local SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy.
author: Ge Gao (Snowflyt) <gaoge011022@gmail.com>

scripts.postinstall: git submodule update --init vendor/tcpip.js vendor/lwip && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; try { execFileSync('git', ['apply', '--reverse', '--check', '../tcpip.js.patch'], { cwd: 'vendor/tcpip.js', stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch { execFileSync('git', ['apply', '../tcpip.js.patch'], { cwd: 'vendor/tcpip.js', stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { stripTypeScriptTypes } from 'node:module'; import path from 'node:path'; const source = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip/src'; const dist = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip/dist'; fs.rmSync(dist, { force: true, recursive: true }); for (const file of fs.readdirSync(source, { encoding: 'utf8', recursive: true })) { if (!file.endsWith('.ts') || /\.test(-d)?\.ts$/.test(file)) continue; const output = path.join(dist, file.replace(/\.ts$/, '.js')); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(output), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(output, stripTypeScriptTypes(fs.readFileSync(path.join(source, file), 'utf8'))); }" && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; if (!fs.existsSync('.cache/wasi-sdk-24')) { const platform = { 'darwin-arm64': 'arm64-macos', 'darwin-x64': 'x86_64-macos', 'linux-arm64': 'arm64-linux', 'linux-x64': 'x86_64-linux', 'win32-x64': 'x86_64-windows' }[process.platform + '-' + process.arch]; if (!platform) throw new Error('wasi-sdk 24 has no build for ' + process.platform + '-' + process.arch); const name = 'wasi-sdk-24.0-' + platform; fs.mkdirSync('.cache', { recursive: true }); execFileSync('curl', ['-fL', '-o', name + '.tar.gz', 'https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-24/' + name + '.tar.gz'], { cwd: '.cache', stdio: 'inherit' }); execFileSync('tar', ['-xzf', name + '.tar.gz'], { cwd: '.cache', stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.rmSync('.cache/' + name + '.tar.gz'); fs.renameSync('.cache/' + name, '.cache/wasi-sdk-24'); }" && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; const tcpip = 'vendor/tcpip.js/packages/tcpip'; const lwip = 'vendor/lwip/src'; const files = (makefile, variable, directory) => new RegExp('^' + variable + '=(.*)', 'm').exec(fs.readFileSync(makefile, 'utf8').replaceAll(/\x5c\r?\n/g, ' '))[1].trim().split(/\s+/).map((file) => file.replace(/^[$][(]\w+[)]/, directory)); execFileSync('.cache/wasi-sdk-24/bin/clang', ['--target=wasm32-wasi', '-I' + lwip + '/include', '-I' + tcpip + '/wasm/include', '-Oz', '-Wall', '-std=c11', '-Wl,--gc-sections,--strip-all,--export=malloc,--export=free,--allow-undefined', '-mexec-model=reactor', '-o', tcpip + '/tcpip.wasm', ...files(tcpip + '/wasm/Filelists.mk', 'SRC_FILES', tcpip + '/wasm'), ...['COREFILES', 'CORE4FILES', 'NETIFFILES'].flatMap((variable) => files(lwip + '/Filelists.mk', variable, lwip))], { stdio: 'inherit' });" && node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.existsSync('.git')) execFileSync('git', ['config', 'core.hooksPath', '.githooks']);"
